blocks.text: Blockchain doston ke group ki mushtarak digital copy jaisa hai jo hisab rakhte hain ke kis ne kis ka qarz dena hai. Ek shakhs ki bajaye sab ke paas copy hoti hai, aur har tabdeeli, jaise qarz wapas karna, ek saath tamam copies mein likhi jati hai.

items: Shaffafiyat: sab copy dekh sakte hain, to dhoka ya chhupi tabdeeli pakri jati hai.
Hifazat: likhne ke baad andraj mitana taqreeban na-mumkin, kyunke cryptography unhein band kar deti hai.
Decentralization: koi ek shakhs ya computer zimmedar nahi; sab ke paas barabar copy, aur tabdeeli ke liye aksariyat ki raza zaroori.

blocks.prompt: Mushtarak copy mein ek dost ke liye dhoka dena mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Baqi sab ke paas wahi record hai aur farq nazar aa jayega, aur tabdeeli ke liye aksariyat ki raza chahiye.

items: Mushtarak copy ki tarah blockchain: shaffaf, mehfooz, decentralized.
